summaryTranslations.hi-IN: Ann Nguyen झुकाव और छीलने वाले एनिमेशन के साथ एक इंटरैक्टिव ग्लिटर स्टिकर प्रभाव बनाने पर GPT-6 Sol के विरुद्ध Claude Opus 5.5 का परीक्षण करती हैं।

caseEvidence.title: Interactive Glitter Sticker Effect with Peel Animation Comparison
caseEvidence.summary: Ann Nguyen tests Claude Opus 5.5 against GPT-6 Sol on building an interactive glitter sticker effect with tilt and peel animations.

model.name: Claude Opus
model.evidence:
asked Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol to create the glitter sticker effect 

seems like Opus 5.5 ate this task

result.evidence: Screen recording shows the interactive sticker components responding to cursor hover with 3D tilt, holographic glitter reflections, and draggable peel back interactions.

inputs.description: Base sticker graphic assets (e.g. 'You're Absolutely Right', 'TypingMind Motion', 'AGI disco planet')
inputs.evidence: Displayed as interactive graphical elements within the screen recording.

tools.name: Web Browser / Canvas / WebGL
tools.role: Execution runtime and interactive renderer for the generated sticker animation code
tools.evidence: The video shows a cursor interacting with interactive canvas/DOM sticker elements in real time.

tools.name: TypingMind
tools.role: Interface/platform used to prompt and run model experiments

caseEvidence.targetModelRole: Generated interactive front-end code (HTML/CSS/Canvas/WebGL) implementing the holographic glitter effect and peel mechanics.
caseEvidence.outputSource: Web browser / interactive canvas rendering runtime executing model-generated code.
caseEvidence.divisionEvidence: Author states she 'asked Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol to create the glitter sticker effect', and records the interactive web UI displaying the rendered results.

video.shots: Single screen-split demonstration showing cursor interaction across multiple sticker designs

caseEvidence.reason: Genuine interactive animation/canvas production demonstrating Claude Opus 5.5 building interactive 3D tilt, glitter, and peel effects recorded on screen.
